notes.title: The Prologue Demo is Releasing on October 13th 2025!
notes.content: [p]We are thrilled to announce that a free playable demo for our upcoming game, [i]Maguntsche Chapter Two[/i], will be available to all players on [b]Monday, October 13th, 2025[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450070/Maguntsche_Chapter_Two_Demo/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]What is the Prologue Demo?[/b][/p][p]The Prologue Demo is an introductory narrative segment of the game. It is designed to introduce you to the world of [i]Maguntsche Chapter Two[/i], its core gameplay loop, and the basic objectives you'll encounter in the full experience. This is the perfect opportunity to get a feel for the atmosphere and mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Your Feedback is Invaluable[/b][/p][p]This demo is more than just a preview; it's a chance for you to help shape the final product. We will be providing channels for players to report any bugs, share their thoughts, and provide general feedback. Your insights will be instrumental in helping us polish the game ahead of its official launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Full Release On Track[/b][/p][p]We are also happy to confirm that development is proceeding as planned, and the full release of [i]Maguntsche Chapter Two[/i] is still on track for its scheduled launch this Fall on [b]Thursday, October 23rd, 2025[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Maguntsche: Chapter Two is Releasing on October 23, 2025!
notes.content: [h2]Maguntsche Chapter Two Releases This Fall![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41465531/b01b229654fa4ceef103c726ec80df5846ffcb95.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Release Date[/u][/h3][p][/p][p]I am pleased to announce that [i]Maguntsche Chapter Two[/i] is scheduled for release on [b]October 23, 2025, at 12:00 PM EST[/b]. Initial availability will be for Windows systems, with consideration for additional platform support in future updates. Expanded platform support could include Mac and Linux systems.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Pricing, Launch Discount, & Bundle Availability[/u][/h3][p][/p][p][i]Maguntsche Chapter Two[/i] will be priced at [b]$9.99[/b], accompanied by a [b]25% launch discount[/b] for a limited promotional period. Furthermore, a "Deluxe Bundle" will be offered, which includes the game's original soundtrack. This bundle is intended to provide additional content for players who wish to further support our development endeavors. The definitive pricing for the Deluxe Bundle is to be determined.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41465531/42c9295ea0f1c025787714593fc020c8724de7ed.png"][/img][/p][h3][u]Gameplay Progression[/u][/h3][p][/p][p]As the launch date approaches, we would like to provide an overview of the anticipated campaign experience. The narrative of [i]Maguntsche Chapter Two[/i] is structured into three distinct playable acts, each contributing critically to the story's linear progression. Following the completion of the prologue—which serves as an introductory segment familiarizing players with core gameplay mechanics—player decisions will exert a significant influence on subsequent narrative choices and outcomes.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]New & Returning Content & Gameplay[/u][/h3][p][/p][p]In addition to the primary campaign, the game incorporates elements designed for completionists, including achievements and the reintroduction of the Archives System from the original game. While the prologue will establish foundational mechanics familiar to returning players, the second and third acts introduce new gameplay features such as stealth, looting, and other non-linear gameplay elements.[/p][p][/p][p]We anticipate sharing further updates in the coming months as the game's release approaches. We encourage and welcome any questions and feedback from the community. Additionally, dedicated support channels will be established for players to report any feedback or bugs on launch day.[/p][p][/p][p]Best Regards,[/p][p][/p][p]Kaleb[/p][p][/p][h2][/h2]
